ui.unpainted: {building} is here, unpainted: just a color and a name on a sign, waiting for somebody to draw it. If you would like to be that somebody, the studio is one tap away.

intro.speaker: Route 10
lines: Late summer in the western Catskills. Route 10 runs north to Jefferson and south-west to Hobart; the road across it is Route 23, which is Main Street through the village.
Walk with the d-pad or the arrow keys. A — or space — talks, reads, and opens doors. Stewart's door, on the corner, actually opens.
The fellow out front looks like he's lost something.

jefferson-stamford.small: east out of Jefferson, then the long swing south — welcome to STAMFORD, Queen of the Catskills.

stamford-jefferson.small: leaving Stamford, past the roadside sign. A few miles north — JEFFERSON.

stamford-hobart.small: south-west out of the village on Hobart Road, down along the West Branch — welcome to HOBART, Jewel of the West Branch.

hobart-stamford.small: back up the West Branch, north-east to STAMFORD, Queen of the Catskills.

_todo.stamford-jefferson: DESIGN.md §5 open item: the real roadside sign leaving Stamford is believed to read something like 'please drive with equanimity', but the wording is UNVERIFIED. Tom is photographing it. The copy above is a deliberate placeholder that does not quote the sign.
